description: Add max_rdn_size: usize field to ValidationPolicy (default 32). In names_match(), before the O(n^2) SET comparison, check that each RDN has <= max_rdn_size AVAs; if exceeded, treat as non-matching. Motivation: theoretical O(n^2) DoS via crafted certs with huge AVA sets. Real-world safe default: 32 AVAs per RDN is far more than any legitimate CA uses. See SECURITY threat model: Algorithmic Complexity (Medium risk).
title: max_rdn_size policy limit in ValidationPolicy
